body:
## Owner approval
Guy approved steps 1–3: file this concept and execute bounded design exploration, NOT implementation. Hermes designer profile requested; profile routing verified by conductor. Independent of #226, which remains PARKED.

## Scope
Two interactive phone-size versions of the SAME screen and data: A refined current ink-wash journal with cleaner rows; B simplified tactile journal with stronger food silhouettes, broad colour shapes, restrained texture and deliberate spacing. Inspired by principles in A Little to the Left, never trace/copy its assets or distinctive compositions. Preserve Morsel palette, typography, navigation and calorie calculation. No full reskin or wholesale food-library rewrite.
Use fictionalized fixture matching owner lunch food names: focaccia, mortadella, stracciatella, grilled vegetables; identical data across variants. Include unknown-food fallback and stored-photo case. Paper and Night. Rows always illustrations, real photo inside detail only (#223). Confidence/source/notes inside sheet; no row verify/manual/confidence or Needs Review section (#227). Label proposed/unshipped behavior honestly.

## Interactions (only two)
1. Tap food row to open detail sheet, subtle lift optional.
2. Save edit and return to updated row with restrained confirmation. Demonstrate pending/failure distinction, no fake server success, Reduce Motion alternative. Prototype state only, no backend or user-data writes. No drag-to-log, rewards for undereating or new page-turn mechanisms.

## Deliverable and acceptance
Two live mobile previews plus side-by-side screenshots and recommendation; reproducible source artifacts and verification. Food recognizable without zoom, nutrition easy to scan, clear accessible detail access, fast tactile response, distinctly original Morsel art. Exercise both interactions, failure and reduced-motion states; no clipped content at phone size. Use original representative art only; do not replace shipped catalog. Read current design tokens/art and relevant issue specs. Future row/detail implementation and remaining library expansion require separate owner approval. Stop at design handoff, no PR merge/main/TestFlight/deploy. Existing fleet continues independently.

## Research sources
https://www.gamedeveloper.com/design/the-methodical-catharsis-of-tidying-in-a-little-to-the-left
https://www.maxinferno.com/press
Refs #223 #227 #198.
